dossier_item_rule_check.name: dossier_item_rule_check
dossier_item_rule_check.value: ("dossier_item"."origin" = 'rule') = ("dossier_item"."rule_key" is not null and "dossier_item"."outcome_key" is not null)

deadline_rule_check.name: deadline_rule_check
deadline_rule_check.value: ("deadline"."origin" = 'rule') = ("deadline"."rule_key" is not null and "deadline"."outcome_key" is not null)

deadline_proof_shape_check.name: deadline_proof_shape_check
deadline_proof_shape_check.value: "deadline_proof"."document_id" is not null or "deadline_proof"."reference" is not null

holiday_rule_shape_check.name: holiday_rule_shape_check
holiday_rule_shape_check.value: ("holiday_rule"."kind" = 'fixed' and "holiday_rule"."month" between 1 and 12 and "holiday_rule"."day" between 1 and 31) or ("holiday_rule"."kind" = 'easter_offset' and "holiday_rule"."offset_days" is not null)

ins_claim_amounts_check.name: ins_claim_amounts_check
ins_claim_amounts_check.value: ("ins_claim"."claimed_cents" is null or "ins_claim"."claimed_cents" >= 0) and ("ins_claim"."received_cents" is null or "ins_claim"."received_cents" >= 0)

ins_coverage_amounts_check.name: ins_coverage_amounts_check
ins_coverage_amounts_check.value: ("ins_coverage"."sum_insured_cents" is null or "ins_coverage"."sum_insured_cents" >= 0) and ("ins_coverage"."deductible_cents" is null or "ins_coverage"."deductible_cents" >= 0)

ins_policy_dates_check.name: ins_policy_dates_check
ins_policy_dates_check.value: "ins_policy"."starts_on" is null or "ins_policy"."ends_on" is null or "ins_policy"."ends_on" >= "ins_policy"."starts_on"

letting_dates_check.name: letting_dates_check
letting_dates_check.value: "letting"."starts_on" is null or "letting"."ends_on" is null or "letting"."ends_on" >= "letting"."starts_on"

letting_amounts_check.name: letting_amounts_check
letting_amounts_check.value: ("letting"."monthly_rent_cents" is null or "letting"."monthly_rent_cents" >= 0) and ("letting"."deposit_cents" is null or "letting"."deposit_cents" >= 0) and ("letting"."deposit_returned_cents" is null or "letting"."deposit_returned_cents" >= 0)
